findings.title: The joined titles folder is no longer cut to the name limits.
findings.body: Before this change, `sanitizeSegment` ran on the joined titles, so the folder name was always cut to 150 bytes. Now each title is slugified on its own (up to 64 characters / 150 bytes each) and the results are joined with `--` with no cut afterwards. A test inside two or three describes with long titles gets a folder name of about 130–200 characters. With non-ASCII titles it reaches 302+ bytes, which is over the 255-byte name limit on ext4 and APFS. Writing the step then fails with `ENAMETOOLONG`, and long paths break the 260-character Windows limit this change says it keeps. Fix: cut the joined name again, for example `cut(titles.map(slugify).join(TITLE_SEPARATOR)).replace(EDGE_PUNCTUATION, "")`, or give the folder its own limit.
